title: The Wickham Road
summary: The buyer's mark in the Abbey's ledger is a pair of scales over a pick: the Kell Assay's, in the Cinder Reach. Sister Ilse is sending you north to Ashgate, to the Charter-Reeve.

steps.journal: Take the Wickham road north out of the Vale, over the range to Ashgate, and find Charter-Reeve Dagny Coalbrook at the Slag & Bellows.

objectives.label: Talk to Dagny Coalbrook in Ashgate

ready: You've found Dagny Coalbrook at the Slag & Bellows. Give her Ilse's letter.
done: Dagny read Ilse's letter standing up. The Assay holds the Slagborn's lease, and her night shift doesn't come home.
